title: Cloud Infrastructure Database Failover Incident Brief
source_document: On August 14, 2026, at 03:12 UTC, the primary US-East Postgres cluster experienced automated failover due to physical storage degradation. Total customer downtime was 4 minutes and 18 seconds. Zero data loss occurred as synchronous replication maintained zero RPO. Recovery was completed at 03:16 UTC with all 14 database nodes returning to healthy state.

Downtime was exactly 4 minutes and 18 seconds.
Zero data loss occurred with zero RPO.
